claims.text: PG's capital expenditures (payments to acquire property, plant and equipment) in fiscal Q4 2026 (2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30) were about $1.023 billion. This is derived from FY2026 capex minus capex for the nine months ended 2026-03-31.

raw_output.summary: Procter & Gamble's capital expenditures in fiscal Q4 2026 (April 1 to June 30, 2026) were about $1.023 billion. This is a derived figure, not one reported directly.
